text: dsh-observation-journal 是一款面向 DSH 的会话观测插件，作为纯观察者订阅会话事件，不注册工具或调用模型。会话运行时它收集任务标题、模型、工具调用与失败、步骤时长和结束状态，并在结束或释放时写入每会话一行的 Markdown 日志，同时追加完整 JSONL sidecar 和汇总统计。日志保留最近配置数量的行，sidecar 保存完整记录。适合希望回看 DSH 任务执行情况、模型使用和工具表现的用户。无需 API 密钥；日志默认位于 DSH_HOME 下，也可用 OBS_FILE 指定路径。

dsh-observation-journal passively records DSH sessions without registering tools or calling a model. It writes task, model, tool, failure, duration, and status details to a Markdown journal, with a JSONL sidecar and usage statistics. OBS_FILE sets the local path; no API key is needed.
我想把每次 DSH 任务的执行情况自动记下来。
有没有办法查看每个会话用了哪些工具、失败了几次？
让 DSH 把模型、任务标题和运行时长整理到日志里。
我想要自动汇总会话总数、工具用量和失败率。
怎样把 agent 的运行记录保存成方便阅读的 Markdown？
想保留完整的会话明细，同时让主日志只显示最近记录。
How can I keep a readable record of each DSH session, including tools and failures?
I need automatic summaries of session counts, tool usage, and failure rates.
dsh-observation-journal 的功能「会话运行记录」：订阅 DSH 会话事件，在运行结束或插件释放时整理任务、模型、工具调用、失败和时长，并写成 Markdown 表格中的一行。
dsh-observation-journal 的功能「运行统计」：写入会话记录后扫描 JSONL sidecar，汇总会话数、工具调用失败率、常用工具和按模型分组的平均时长。
dsh-observation-journal 的功能「完整记录与保留上限」：每次刷新追加完整 JSONL 会话记录，并仅在 Markdown 卡片中保留最近 maxRows 行；可通过配置调整行数。
dsh-observation-journal 的功能「日志脱敏与表格清理」：写入前按内置规则和可选自定义正则处理任务描述，并清除控制字符、转义竖线与换行，避免日志表格被打乱。
dsh-observation-journal 会将会话任务描述、模型与工具统计保存在 observations.md 和追加式 JSONL sidecar；默认写入 DSH_HOME 下，路径可由 OBS_FILE 覆盖。

dsh-observation-journal README · dsh-observation-journal：**Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DeepSeek Harness: every session writes its own report card.**

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 简体中文版见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A pure observer plugin (zero tools registered, zero LLM calls, zero agent involvement). When a session ends, it writes the run's facts — task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status — into a human-readable journal with an auto-updated stats section.

dsh-observation-journal README · Why it exists：Failures have a recorder ([dsh-fail-logger](https://github.com/Areium/dsh-fail-logger)). Successes and run facts didn't. This is the sibling: **what happened** — not how to solve it, not what to remember. No tools, no injection, no retrieval. The harness writes passively; humans and projects read.

dsh-observation-journal README · Why it exists：**What it is not** (boundaries, stated plainly):
| Plugin | Records | Injects back into agent? | Consumption |
|---|---|---|---|
| **this** | run facts (telemetry) | never | human/project file |
| dsh-task-planner | solutions ("how to solve") | yes (recall) | agent planning |
| dsh-mneme / dsh-memento / dsh-memory | agent memories | yes (retrieval) | agent context |
| dsh-fail-logger | failures | via skill | agent skill loading |

dsh-observation-journal README · 60-second verification：```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add <repo-or-pkg>   # or copy the repo as a local bundle
dsh --profile headless "run any small task"
cat ~/.dsh/observations.md                        # a journal row + stats section appeared
```

dsh-observation-journal README · What the output looks like：The journal is the UI. A marker section that survives manual edits, plus an auto-stats block:

```markdown
<!-- OBS-JOURNAL:BEGIN -->
| time | sid | task | model | dur | turns | tools | calls | fail | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-14T21:42 | abe96e0f | 阅读 specs/s11-1.md 任务书 | deepseek-v4-pro(max) | 1242 | 1 | read:80,bash:12,edit:9,todo_write:4 | 106 | 0 | completed |

dsh-observation-journal README · What the output looks like：**raw sidecar** (`obsFile + '.jsonl'`, append-only): full fidelity — todo planning trace (≤5), complete tool counts, failed tools, full model id, full task description, normalized `task_hash`. This is the v2 material for LLM insight; it is TTL-decoupled from the card.

dsh-observation-journal README · Config (all optional, patch `config:` field)：| key | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `obsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/observations.md` | journal path (point it at a project-level file) |
| `maxRows` | `200` | card keeps last N rows (raw sidecar unaffected) |
| `marker` | `OBS-JOURNAL` | section marker id, `[A-Za-z0-9-]` |
| `redact` | `[]` | extra redaction regexes (stacked on the built-in secret table) |
| `flushMs` | `300` | trailing debounce after turn/end |
dsh-observation-journal README · Config (all optional, patch `config:` field)：Env: `OBS_FILE` overrides `obsFile`; `OBS_REPLAY=<session.jsonl>` replays real events (test/CI mode).

dsh-observation-journal README · Reliability：- 10-column card rows: one row per session — no lossy merging
- Task title escapes `|` and newlines; secrets redacted (same table as fail-logger)
- Cross-process write lock + stale lock reclaim; dispose fallback flushes sessions with no turn/end
- **Tested against real session logs**: 14/14 replay tests on 5 real .zstd fixtures (incl. a 2000+ event Pro long-synthesis session), field-by-field cross-checked against independent recomputation; 21-session full replay verified human sections byte-identical

dsh-observation-journal README · Development：```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --test tests/test.mjs   # needs python3 + zstandard
```
